title: Integrate qualified Craig interpolation

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 qualified Craig-interpolation capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current ipfs_datasets source forest already supplies the reusable, versioned ValidatedCraigInterpolation@1 authority and its checked public facade. It qualifies cvc5 only for QF_LIA production, requires fresh independent Z3 checks for A => I and I & B unsatisfiability, structurally limits interpolant vocabulary to the shared vocabulary, carries explicit bounds, and canonically binds partitions, interpolant, validation checks, and receipt identities. The declared-output boundary permits only this receipt, so no duplicate interpolation adapter, source mutation, or competing PCSM authority was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The existing implementation and direct positive/negative tests are present and pass in the provider environment, but the authoritative sealed environment has neither the cvc5 producer API nor the independent z3 validator. Its required pytest command also aborts before collection because its explicitly configured anyio plugin is unavailable. No canonical PCSM current-source-map CID binds a current source file/node/span forest to an interpolation partition. This receipt therefore records the reusable authority without claiming sealed interpolation usability, a current-forest execution, or promotion.

evidence_legend.simulated: A controlled provider-environment execution; it cannot replace sealed validation or authorize promotion.
evidence_legend.unavailable: A required identity, capability, or result absent from the authoritative environment; it is neither zero nor passing.

freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any change to a bound commit/tree, gitlink head/tree, scheduler digest, listed source digest, required-test configuration/result, cvc5/z3 capability, interpolation contract, or current PCSM source-map capability requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree aggregate PCSM source-map CID or canonical CodeIR/source identity to exact current file/node/span resolution is present in the task-owned implementation/test roots. Interpolation partition CIDs identify SMT terms, not the absent PCSM current-source identities; Git trees, blobs, and local test node IDs are not substitutes.

components.role: cvc5 is the sole qualified producer for QF_LIA. A returned term is admitted only after independently opening fresh Z3 sessions to validate A => I and I & B unsatisfiability, checking structural shared vocabulary, and checking partition/interpolant/receipt identities and resource bounds.
Checked public facade that requires present partitions and verifies that the returned object has the declared schema, interface, and receipt_cid before exposing it.

determinism_and_binding.profile: InterpolationBounds canonicalizes timeout, memory, symbol, term-node, theory, and schema limits. ValidatedInterpolantReceipt canonicalizes vocabularies and fallback-core names; receipt_cid is a canonical identity over the schema-bound receipt. Partition CIDs, interpolant CID, independent validation receipt CIDs, and the aggregate receipt CID bind the result. A validated status requires every admission check; a fallback status must have no interpolant and must carry separately validated unsat-core authority.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: Z3 availability is not interpolation support; it is an independent validator only. Unsupported theory, producer/API absence, validator absence, failed validation, satisfiable partitions, and bound failure produce typed non-success. Unsat-core fallback is explicitly labelled fallback and is never rewritten as an interpolant. Independent solver diversity is not kernel reconstruction or mutation authority.
determinism_and_binding.current_pcsm_execution_binding: unavailable because canonical PCSM source-map/CID inputs and a usable sealed qualified producer/validator are both absent.

source_inventory.role: Versioned qualified Craig-interpolation implementation, deterministic semantic identities, explicit bounds, independent Z3 admission, typed unavailable dispositions, and explicitly non-interpolant unsat-core fallback.
Checked public API exposure of ValidatedCraigInterpolation@1 and validated-craig-interpolant/v1.
Direct positive and negative qualified-interpolation contract coverage.
Public-facade interpolation schema/interface/receipt-CID coverage and malformed-partition rejection.

positive_coverage: A live QF_LIA cvc5 interpolant is independently validated by Z3: A => I, I & B unsatisfiability, structural shared vocabulary, identity, and bounds must all pass.
Equivalent admitted interpolants have stable canonical identities; partition, interpolant, validation-receipt, and aggregate receipt CIDs are asserted.
The public facade returns the declared ValidatedCraigInterpolation@1 interface and validated-craig-interpolant/v1 receipt schema.
negative_coverage: Unsupported theories and unqualified Z3 production are rejected; solver availability alone is not interpolation support.

Absent providers, missing producer API, blocked independent validator, jointly satisfiable partitions, malformed requests, invalid receipt schema, and incomplete validated/fallback receipts produce exceptions or typed non-success rather than a fabricated interpolant.
Unavailable interpolation can expose only a validated unsat-core fallback, never an interpolant; optional solver imports remain cold until requested.
positive_and_negative_test_sources.coverage_limit: The direct tests validate the reusable interpolation authority and checked facade. They do not create a PCSM source-map-bound current-forest partition or turn solver observations into kernel-checked proofs.

limitations: This exact-output dispatch is receipt-only. It selects and validates an existing current-head authority but does not modify the datasets implementation/tests or create a competing interpolation subsystem.
Qualified production is limited to cvc5 QF_LIA with the experimental interpolation API and independent Z3 validation; independent solver diversity is not kernel reconstruction.
Both required Python APIs are absent in the authoritative sealed environment. The available provider-environment solvers do not satisfy that sealed-environment gate.
A validated unsat core is fallback authority only and is never an interpolant; no failure or unavailable disposition is promoted into a success.
A current aggregate PCSM source-map CID is unavailable, so no interpolation partition is claimed to bind an exact current PCSM file/node/span forest.
The required PCSM suite passed only in the provider environment and could not collect in the sealed environment; it cannot be relabelled as a sealed package validation pass.
No model output is accepted as evidence or mutation authority, and no M2/M3 mutation, generated-source mutation, automatic source materialization, or promotion is authorized.
The receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
